subject.title: fix(memory-host-sdk): resolve stable execPath for worker fork to survive Homebrew Node upgrades

question: Should maintainers require target macOS/Homebrew Gateway proof and choose this pre-resolve branch as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99183 before merge?
rationale: The code path is narrow and appears correct, but the contributor has not shown the target after-upgrade runtime behavior and multiple open PRs propose competing fixes for the same issue.

options.title: Require target proof and converge on one PR
options.body: Ask for redacted macOS/Homebrew Gateway terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a fresh worker fork succeeds after the stale Cellar executable is unavailable, then pick one canonical candidate.

options.title: Accept source and mocked coverage
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally override the proof gap and land this pre-resolve strategy based on source review plus mocked resolver tests.

options.title: Pause behind another candidate
options.body: Keep this branch paused if maintainers prefer the retry approach, a combined approach, or a narrower sibling branch for the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Require target proof and converge on one PR
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted macOS/Homebrew Gateway terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a fresh worker fork succeeds after the stale Cellar executable is unavailable, then pick one canonical candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz has the strongest feature-history connection to the local embedding worker isolation and failure-handling surface affected by the choice.
